tweet.text:
I just left the vet and we believe there is something wrong with my best friend

I’ve had Tahoe since he was born and he is 10 now 

Can’t say for sure what is wrong but it doesn’t look good and I will be aggressively seeking treatment and answers 

This is very hard for me and I will be doing everything I can to make sure I take care of whatever is wrong with him
